description: In crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs lines 180-182, has_direct_create is computed by comparing v.get("kind").and_then(|k| k.as_str()) == Some("direct") against the raw client-supplied JSON string. The check is case-sensitive and lowercase-only. If a client sends "kind": "Direct" (uppercase D) or any other case variant, has_direct_create is false, the pre-fetch of existing chats is skipped, existing_chats remains empty, and the duplicate-direct-chat pre-check at line 246 never fires for that create. The post-create race detection guard at line 373 also relies on is_direct_create which is computed from ChatKind::Direct matching — but that match uses the impl_string_enum deserialization which is also case-sensitive, so "Direct" lands in ChatKind::Other and is_direct_create is false there too, meaning neither guard fires. A client sending "Direct" (or "DIRECT") can silently create duplicate Direct chats. Fix: normalize kind string to lowercase before the has_direct_create check, or derive it from the ChatKind enum value after deserialization.
title: Chat/set: has_direct_create bypassed by non-lowercase kind string
